description: Explore W5's crux (proposed H2.3 child): the accuracy cost of the low-res phases depends on the final feature-map regime (3×3 vs 2×2 after group 3), not on pixel count. Feature-map sizes: 32→31/15/7/3, 28→27/13/6/3, 26→25/12/6/3, 24→23/11/5/2. E018 replaced the 28 px phase (3×3 regime) with 24 px (2×2 regime) and lost 0.68 pp. On the E017 recipe (or I033's if kept), change only the middle phase from 28 px to 26 px, keeping the 40/30/30% step split. The 26 px phase stays in the 3×3 regime with about 14% fewer pixels. Warm up and capture the 26 px graph in build with channels_last tensors from the training code path, and keep error_on_recompile on. Judge accuracy on held-out seeds 3–12 as well as on seeds 0–2.
